description: Ilrika wears a rich navy-blue floor-length gown with an opaque fitted bodice, low square neckline and elaborate narrow gold woven trim at the neckline, central panel, sleeves and hem. Round shoulder brooches and a small pendant provide restrained metal decoration. A wide decorated belt with a central round fastening defines the waist. Ivory linen underlayers show at the wrists and skirt front. A blue-gray and cream border-woven shawl drapes across her forearms. Dark leather shoes are visible beneath the hem. The materials remain substantial and fully opaque.
